conditions.clean: flat ground, production blur and registration
conditions.wider_blur: extra optical/resampling blur of 0.8 px the detector does not model
conditions.registration_1px: frame-to-frame registration jitter of 1 px (detector assumes 0.5 px)
conditions.ripples_1deg: elephant-hide ripples, 6 m wavelength, 1 deg maximum slope, DEM reports flat
conditions.ripples_3deg: the same ripples at 3 deg maximum slope
conditions.tilt_away_1deg: ground falls 1 deg along the mean down-Sun direction, DEM reports flat
conditions.tilt_toward_1deg: ground rises 1 deg along the mean down-Sun direction, DEM reports flat
conditions.second_rock_downsun: a second rock of the same height 2.5 m down-Sun of the target
conditions.boulder_field: the target inside a field of 0.2-1.0 m rocks covering 3% of the ground
conditions.sfs_corrected_ripples: ripples at 3 deg, then the T14 linear shape-from-shading correction
conditions.no_rock_ripples_3deg: ripples at 3 deg and no rock: anything sized is not a caster
conditions.no_rock_boulder_field: the boulder field without the target rock at the cell centre
conditions.sfs_corrected_flat: flat ground, then the T14 linear shape-from-shading correction
conditions.sfs_image_only_ripples: ripples at 3 deg, the corrected images sized on the DEM plane (no SfS surface)
conditions.sfs_surface_only_ripples: ripples at 3 deg, the original images sized on the SfS surface

interpretation: Synthetic paired trials; mechanisms, not a measured bias on real images. Heights are equivalent rectangular-shadow heights from the final adaptive pass.
